food_name: Mature Shan Tuyet green tea leaves (thermally stabilized powder)
geographical_origin: Tan Tien ward, Tuyen Quang province, Vietnam
mapping_review_rationale: Independent identity adjudication: Stage B PubChem CID 6419835 and full InChIKey LSHVYAFMTMFKBA-CTNGQTDRSA-N match the source stereospecific (−)-catechin gallate standard. PubChem record plus independent chemical identity registry checked. Stage B was not edited.
moisture_basis: Dry leaf powder basis as reported; 60 °C oven-dried for 12 h before analysis; source table reports mg/g dry weight.
analytical_method: Validated HPLC-UV/DAD; pure >98% analyte standard; baseline separation; analyte-specific calibration; R²>0.999
extraction_method: Tea powder extraction; baseline raw-material composition before extraction-process experiments
source_title: Optimization of Green Processes for Catechin Extraction and Evaluation of the Antioxidant Activity of Extracts from Shan Tuyet Tea Leaves in Vietnam
extraction_notes: Table 2 reports 3.1, 3.5, 3.3 mg/g in three independent batches and mean ± SD 3.3 ± 0.2. Compound identity measured against a >98% authentic (−)-catechin gallate standard. Normalized by unit conversion only: 1 mg/g = 1000 mg/kg.
uncertainty_notes: Mean ± SD = 3.3 ± 0.2 mg/g (n=3 independent batches). Source notes thermal stabilization altered native profile; these are processed tea leaves, not fresh leaf values.

geographical_origin: Korea; single tea garden, source reported
mapping_review_rationale: Independent identity adjudication: Stage B PubChem CID 5276890 and full InChIKey WMBWREPUVVBILR-GHTZIAJQSA-N match the source stereospecific (+)-gallocatechin gallate analyte; FDA Substance Registration System maps this key to (+)-gallocatechin gallate. Stage B was not edited.
moisture_basis: Concentration per g of processed green tea as reported; source does not specify a dry-matter correction. No moisture conversion applied.
analytical_method: HPLC catechin quantification; source identifies (+)-gallocatechin gallate as GCg and uses stereospecific catechin standards; see article Methods.
extraction_method: Tea leaf extraction and processing as described by source; no recipe conversion.
sample_size: Four plucking periods; source reports mean ± SD but replicate count not specified in extracted record.
source_title: Quantitative Analysis of Major Constituents in Green Tea with Different Plucking Periods and Their Antioxidant Activity
extraction_notes: Table 1 reports mean ± SD 6.73 ± 0.06 mg/g; GCg explicitly defined as (+)-gallocatechin gallate. Converted mg/g to mg/kg arithmetically. Source has four harvest/plucking periods; no extra density/moisture conversion.
uncertainty_notes: Source does not state the replicate count adjacent to Table 1 in the accessible paper text. These are source-specific processed tea values, not a population estimate.
